questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L G _ Q _ G P _ L _ P Q _ G _ Q

options.text: P, L, P, G, L, Q
P, L, Q, G, L, P
P, Q, L, G, P, L
P, P, L, G, Q, L

questions.solution:
Given sequence: L G _ Q _ G P _ L _ P Q _ G _ Q

 
• P, L, P, G, L, Q → L G **P** Q - **L** G P **P -** L **G** P Q - **L** G **Q** Q
 
• P, L, Q, G, L, P → L G **P** Q - **L** G P **Q** - L **G** P Q - **L** G **P** Q
 
• P, Q, L, G, P, L → L G **P** Q - **Q** G P **L -** L **G** P Q - **P** G **L** Q
 
• P, P, L, G, Q, L → L G **P** Q - **P** G P **L -** L **G** P Q - **Q** G **L** Q

 
• In option 2, LGPQ is repeated.

Hence, '**P, L, Q, G, L, P**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

P _ Q U _ V _ T _ U R V P T Q _ R _ P _ Q U _ V

options.text: P, T, Q, R, T, V, R, U
R, T, P, Q, T, U, R, V
T, P, R, Q, T, U, V, R
T, R, P, Q, U, V, T, R

questions.solution:
Given: P _ Q U _ V _ T _ U R V P T Q _ R _ P _ Q U _ V

1) P, T, Q, R, T, V, R, U → P **P** Q U **T** V - **Q** T **R** U R V - P T Q **T** R **V -** P **R** Q U **U** V

2) R, T, P, Q, T, U, R, V → P **R** Q U **T** V - **P** T **Q** U R V - P T Q T R **U -** P R Q U **V** V

3) T, P, R, Q, T, U, V, R → P **T** Q U **P** V - **R** T Q U R V - P T Q T R U - P **V** Q U **R** V

4) T, R, P, Q, U, V, T, R → P T Q U **R** V - **P** T Q U R V - P T Q **U** R **V -** P **T** Q U R V

Correct cyclic pattern is **"P T Q U R V"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"T, R, P, Q, U, V, T, R".**

Z Y R _ Z _ R R Z Y _ R _ Y R _
questions.solution:
Given : Z Y R _ Z _ R R Z Y _ R _ Y R _

• R Y R Z R → Z Y R __**R**__ Z __**Y**__ R R Z Y __**R**__ R __**Z**__ Y R __**R**__ → (It follows the pattern of : ZYRR - ZYRR - ZYRR - ZYRR) 
 
• Z R Y Z R → Z Y R **__Z__** Z **__R__** R R Z Y **__Y__** R __Z__ Y R __R__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• R Z R Y Z → Z Y R __R__ Z **__Z__** R R Z Y __R__ R **__Y__** Y R **__Z__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• Z R R Y Z → Z Y R **__Z__** Z **__R__** R R Z Y __R__ R **__Y__** Y R Z__ __→ (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of "Z Y R __R__ - Z __Y__ R R - Z Y __R__ R - __Z__ Y R __R__"

Hence, "**R Y R Z R**" is the correct answer.
